premises.text: Spine surgeons cannot see screw paths inside vertebrae; malposition is common and screen-based navigation forces looking away from the patient, so navigation is underused
premises.evidence_span: All the current solutions for navigation are uncomfortable for the surgeons, they're not intuitive

premises.text: A patented see-through visor projects patient anatomy in real time onto the surgeon's retina with surgical precision and depth perception
premises.evidence_span: project the patient anatomy in real time directly onto the surgeon's retina with surgical precision and with outstanding depth perception

premises.text: Business model integrates the visor into existing surgical navigation and imaging systems sold with global partners
premises.evidence_span: Our business model is to integrate the visor into existing surgical navigation systems and medical imaging systems

value.text: Surgeons can navigate while looking at the patient, seeing anatomy through skin and tissue for safer screw placement
value.evidence_span: give surgeons an x-ray vision, so they can see the patient's anatomy through the skin and tissue
